title: StatusAssertion (STATUS-v1, v1.0) — signed short-lived per-UID status capability
description: D6 (F-10/X-07): the EDD core registry's signed, SHORT-LIVED assertion of a UID's lifecycle status. An RDP may rely on a valid (unexpired) assertion — even offline — for legal-effect issuance (umbrella §5.7); a suspension simply stops new assertions being issued, so after the held assertion expires the RDP fails closed. The hard expiry bounds the concealment window: a suspension can hide for AT MOST the remaining validity of the last assertion issued before it — bounded and disclosed (≤ 5 minutes). Sealed as a COSE_Sign1 artefact under the EDD core-registry key (directory registry_seal_keys pin; production: Trusted-List-anchored). Emergency revocation = stop issuing + the hard expiry; no revocation list exists at this validity.

redirect_uid.description: REQUIRED iff status is merged — the surviving entity's UID.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry. expires_at − issued_at MUST NOT exceed the suspension-propagation bound (5 minutes) — LINT-DISC-25.

assertion_id.description: ULID replay guard — unique per issuance.
